summary: @ornikar/eslint-plugin-ornikar preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares an ESLint plugin purpose but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip`, extracts and chmods it executable, then uses `execFileSync` to invoke Bun against a bundled 727KB sibling file `math_init.js`. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated with `_0x`-prefixed identifiers, per-function string maps, and a rotating-array string decoder (obfuscator.io shape). The preinstall fires automatically on `npm install`. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled payload has no relationship to the advertised ESLint plugin purpose and matches the alternate-runtime dropper pattern used to evade Node-based install scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
